title: BrainPro: Process-conditioned Pretraining with Topographic Retrieval for Large EEG Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.22050v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: EEG foundation models are pretrained on heterogeneous corpora, but two challenges remain underexplored: (1) experimental protocols provide mental-process cues that are rarely used in masked pretraining, and (2) electrode montages vary across datasets, making spatial representations montage-dependent. Existing methods typically learn a single general-purpose representation and model spatial structure implicitly, limiting their ability to exploit process-related information under montage heterogeneity. translated_title: BrainPro：面向大型脑电图模型的过程条件化预训练与拓扑检索方法
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型通常在异构语料库上进行预训练，但存在两个尚未被充分探索的挑战：（1）实验范式提供了心理过程线索，但在掩码预训练中很少被利用；（2）不同数据集的电极导联配置各不相同，导致空间表征依赖于特定的导联配置。现有方法通常只学习单一通用表征，并隐式地对空间结构进行建模，这限制了它们在导联配置异构性条件下利用过程相关信息的能力。我们提出了BrainPro，这是一个过程条件化的自监督预训练框架，它将拓扑检索与共享表征及过程关联表征学习相结合。BrainPro将数据集特定的导联配置映射到通用的通道-区域模板上，并检索通道级和区域级空间滤波器，从而形成一个拓扑对齐的空间基底。在此基底之上，BrainPro学习一个共享编码器以捕捉通用的EEG结构，……
tldr: BrainPro提出了一种过程条件化的自监督预训练框架，通过拓扑检索将不同数据集的电极导联配置映射到通用通道-区域模板，并同时学习共享表征与过程关联表征，从而解决EEG基础模型中心理过程线索利用不足和导联配置异构两大挑战。
en_tdlr: BrainPro is a process-conditioned self-supervised pretraining framework that couples topographic retrieval with shared and process-associated representation learning, mapping heterogeneous electrode montages to a universal channel-region template to address underexplored mental-process cues and montage heterogeneity in EEG foundation models.
